prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Spawn Preparation Screen: Introduce a dedicated desktop pet spawn screen before waiting, showing a live preview animation of pet placement on desktop. (why: Support logs indicate 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app launch stalls, while waiting stage takes a long median duration of 201s.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload & Adoption Step-by-Step Flow: Rebuild the photo upload screen into a checklist layout with live progress tracking and photo formatting advice. (why: Support received emails regarding custom pet generation failures/visual errors, and adoption drops off to 60.9% with a mean time of 1017s.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Cloud Sync Warning Hint: Add an explicit status hint on the sign-in screen explaining that cloud sign-in prevents pet progress resets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again under account issues.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Status and Notification Opt-In: Display rendering time estimates and enable background notification opt-in on the waiting screen while the pet is prepared. (why: The waiting step (home target) has a very long mean duration (2336s) causing user abandonment.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Interaction Mastery Call-to-Action Copy: Update home_intro text copy to give explicit directions on summoning and hiding the desktop pet. (why: Completion conversion drops to 64.8% and post-onboarding support shows user confusion on desktop pet commands (3 emails).)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Delivery System Notification Prompt: Add a ready notification prompt toggle and progress bar on the waiting screen so users get alerted when setup completes. (why: Home waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to drop off before reaching finish.)
